lines.zh: 我踩着苔藓走，菌盖一晃一晃。
lines.en: I walk on moss, my cap bobbing with each step.

lines.zh: 孢子从我身后飘起来。
lines.en: Spores drift up behind me.

lines.zh: 树根挡路，我慢慢跨过去。
lines.en: A root blocks the way; I step over it slowly.

lines.zh: 我只在阴凉里走，太阳太晒。
lines.en: I keep to the shade; the sun is too strong.

lines.zh: 泥土是软的，我的脚陷进去半寸。
lines.en: The soil is soft, and my feet sink half an inch.

lines.zh: 我绕过一丛同类，怕碰坏它们的菌盖。
lines.en: I skirt a patch of kin so I won't bruise their caps.

lines.zh: 湿气重的地方，我走得快些。
lines.en: Where the air is damp, I walk a little faster.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，留下浅浅的菌丝。
lines.en: Faint mycelium marks where I've walked.

lines.zh: 我的影子在蘑菇地上是圆的。
lines.en: My shadow on the mushroom field is round.

lines.zh: 我低头走，怕踩到刚冒头的小菌。
lines.en: I walk head down so I don't crush new sprouts.

lines.zh: 雨刚停，林子里到处是水声。
lines.en: The rain just stopped, and the wood drips everywhere.

lines.zh: 我往林子深处走，那里更暗也更潮。
lines.en: I head deeper in, where it's darker and damper.

lines.zh: 走几步，我就停下来看看菌盖。
lines.en: Every few steps I stop and check my cap.

lines.zh: 我用菌柄拨开挡路的蕨叶。
lines.en: I push fern leaves aside with my stalk.

lines.zh: 我沿着倒木走，菌盖蹭到树皮。
lines.en: I walk along the fallen log, my cap brushing the bark.

lines.zh: 步子放轻，别把孢子全抖落。
lines.en: I keep my steps light so the spores stay on.

lines.zh: 我把菌盖压低，像撑一把伞。
lines.en: I lower my cap as if holding an umbrella.

lines.zh: 孢子慢慢落下来，像很细的雨。
lines.en: Spores settle slowly, like very fine rain.

lines.zh: 我在树影里站着，一动不动。
lines.en: I stand in the tree's shadow without moving.

lines.zh: 菌褶里积了一点水，我晃了晃。
lines.en: Water pools in my gills; I sway to shed it.

lines.zh: 有只蜗牛爬上我的菌柄，我没赶它。
lines.en: A snail climbs my stalk, and I let it stay.

lines.zh: 我想汤的味道了，虽然刚喝过。
lines.en: I think about soup, though I just had some.

lines.zh: 泥土里有东西在动，可能是蚯蚓。
lines.en: Something stirs in the soil, maybe an earthworm.

lines.zh: 我把根须往湿土里送了送。
lines.en: I settle my roots deeper into the wet soil.

lines.zh: 这片蘑菇地，每年都长得更密。
lines.en: This mushroom field grows denser every year.

lines.zh: 我给身边的小菌让了点阴影。
lines.en: I lean to share my shade with a small sprout.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我能听见菌丝在长。
lines.en: In the quiet, I can hear my mycelium growing.

lines.zh: 我数了数自己菌盖上的斑点。
lines.en: I count the spots on my own cap.

lines.zh: 天黑之前，我得把孢子散完。
lines.en: Before dark, I should finish releasing spores.

lines.zh: 风穿过林子，我的菌盖轻轻响。
lines.en: Wind moves through the wood, and my cap rustles.

lines.zh: 一只甲虫爬过菌褶，我屏住不动。
lines.en: A beetle crawls over my gills; I hold still.

lines.zh: 水从菌盖边缘滴下来，一滴一滴。
lines.en: Water drips from my cap's rim, one drop at a time.

lines.zh: 你带着碗，是来要汤的吗？
lines.en: You brought a bowl — have you come for soup?

lines.zh: 菌伞下积着汤，你低头找碗。
lines.en: Soup pools under my cap; you look down for a bowl.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，菌盖差点翻过去。
lines.en: I look up, and my cap nearly tips over.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来时，我们差不多高。
lines.en: When you crouch, we're about the same height.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁锅的味道。
lines.en: You smell of an iron pot.

lines.zh: 你伸手摸我，我得先站稳。
lines.en: You reach to touch me; let me brace myself.

lines.zh: 你的影子里凉，我往那边挪了挪。
lines.en: Your shadow is cool, so I shift toward it.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的碗，看了很久。
lines.en: I stare at your bowl for a long while.

lines.zh: 你不像林子里的其他东西。
lines.en: You don't look like anything else in this wood.

lines.zh: 你说话时，孢子被你吹开了。
lines.en: When you speak, your breath scatters my spores.

lines.zh: 我歪着菌盖，想看清你的脸。
lines.en: I tilt my cap to see your face.

lines.zh: 你脚边刚冒出一朵小菌，别踩。
lines.en: A small mushroom just sprouted by your foot — mind it.

lines.zh: 菌盖被削掉一块，孢子涌出来。
lines.en: A chunk of my cap is cut away, and spores pour out.

lines.zh: 我歪倒了，又一点点立起来。
lines.en: I topple, then right myself bit by bit.

lines.zh: 这一下让我缩成一团。
lines.en: The blow makes me curl into a ball.

lines.zh: 白色的汁液渗出来，黏黏的。
lines.en: Pale juice seeps out, sticky to the touch.

lines.zh: 我的菌褶都乱了。
lines.en: My gills are all out of order.

lines.zh: 我往湿土里缩了半截。
lines.en: I sink halfway into the wet soil.

lines.zh: 根须断了三根，我数得清。
lines.en: Three roots snapped; I can count them.

lines.zh: 我发出很轻的一声，像挤汤。
lines.en: I make a small sound, like soup being squeezed.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的斑点掉了两个。
lines.en: That blow knocked two spots off me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到树影里。
lines.en: I inch my way into the tree's shadow.

lines.zh: 你拿着碗，我就知道要做什么。
lines.en: You hold out a bowl, and I know what to do.

lines.zh: 我站定，把菌盖朝向你的碗。
lines.en: I plant my feet and angle my cap toward your bowl.

lines.zh: 你轻轻一挤，我就配合着倾。
lines.en: You squeeze lightly, and I tip along with it.

lines.zh: 这碗汤够浓，你闻闻。
lines.en: This bowl is thick enough — smell it.

lines.zh: 我特地多存了些，给你留着。
lines.en: I saved a little extra, just for you.

lines.zh: 别急，一滴一滴才不洒。
lines.en: Easy; drop by drop, so nothing spills.

lines.zh: 你碗里的热气，让我想打喷嚏。
lines.en: The steam from your bowl makes me want to sneeze.

lines.zh: 我用菌柄扶住碗边，怕它翻。
lines.en: I steady the bowl's rim with my stalk so it won't tip.

lines.zh: 汤里有蘑菇味，也有土味。
lines.en: The soup tastes of mushroom and of soil.

lines.zh: 你喝一口，我就松一口气。
lines.en: You take a sip, and I relax a little.

lines.zh: 我把最浓的那部分留给你。
lines.en: I keep the richest part for you.

lines.zh: 你伸手时，我先缩了缩菌盖。
lines.en: When you reach out, I shrink my cap first.

lines.zh: 再挤就空了，得等明天。
lines.en: Squeeze more and I'm empty; wait until tomorrow.

lines.zh: 你舔了舔碗边，我有点得意。
lines.en: You lick the rim, and I feel a bit proud.

lines.zh: 你端着空碗来，我就往前挪。
lines.en: You come with an empty bowl, and I shuffle forward.

lines.zh: 汤面上浮着几片碎菌，别嫌弃。
lines.en: A few bits of cap float in the soup; don't mind them.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，孢子扑了你一脸。
lines.en: You bump me, and spores puff into your face.

lines.zh: 我太软了，被顶得歪向一边。
lines.en: I'm too soft; the shove bends me sideways.

lines.zh: 别踩我的根，那里连着整片菌丝。
lines.en: Don't step on my roots; they link the whole field.

lines.zh: 你从我旁边挤过去，菌盖蹭掉了粉。
lines.en: You squeeze past, brushing powder off my cap.

lines.zh: 我被撞得转了个方向，慢慢转回来。
lines.en: The bump turns me around; I turn back slowly.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖碰到我，我晃了三下。
lines.en: Your knee hits me, and I sway three times.

lines.zh: 我让开半步，根须还留在原地。
lines.en: I step aside, but my roots stay where they were.

lines.zh: 撞完之后，地上多了一层孢子。
lines.en: After the bump, a layer of spores coats the ground.

lines.zh: 你退开，我才把菌盖扶正。
lines.en: You step back, and I straighten my cap.

lines.zh: 我不疼，只是有点晕。
lines.en: It doesn't hurt, but I'm a little dizzy.

lines.zh: 我们的菌丝在土下连到了一起。
lines.en: Our mycelium has joined beneath the soil.

lines.zh: 我把孢子吹向她那边。
lines.en: I blow my spores toward her.

lines.zh: 两朵菌盖靠在一起，像两把伞。
lines.en: Two caps lean together like a pair of umbrellas.

lines.zh: 她不说话，只是慢慢晃。
lines.en: She says nothing, only sways slowly.

lines.zh: 我们分着同一片湿土。
lines.en: We share the same patch of wet soil.

lines.zh: 夜里我们的孢子混在一起。
lines.en: At night our spores mingle.

lines.zh: 我替她挡了会儿风。
lines.en: I shelter her from the wind for a while.

lines.zh: 她的斑点比我的多三个。
lines.en: She has three more spots than I do.

lines.zh: 我们挨着长，谁也不挤谁。
lines.en: We grow side by side without crowding.

lines.zh: 根须缠在一起，分不开了。
lines.en: Our roots have tangled and won't come apart.

lines.zh: 我把落下的枯叶顶在菌盖上。
lines.en: I balance a fallen leaf on my cap.

lines.zh: 这块湿木头，正好垫在根下。
lines.en: This wet wood will do under my roots.

lines.zh: 我卷起一根草茎，夹在菌柄边。
lines.en: I curl a grass stem and tuck it by my stalk.

lines.zh: 那颗松果太重，我推着走。
lines.en: The pinecone is too heavy, so I push it.

lines.zh: 我把石子围成一圈，护住小菌。
lines.en: I ring pebbles around the small sprouts.

lines.zh: 我捡起一片羽毛，不知是谁的。
lines.en: I pick up a feather and wonder whose it was.

lines.zh: 这枚果核会烂，正好当肥料。
lines.en: This fruit pit will rot and feed the soil.

lines.zh: 我抱着东西时，走路更慢了。
lines.en: Carrying something, I walk even slower.

lines.zh: 东西从菌盖上滑下来，我又顶上去。
lines.en: It slides off my cap, and I lift it back.

lines.zh: 我把捡来的都堆在树根旁。
lines.en: I pile my finds beside the tree roots.

lines.zh: 有东西踩乱了菌丝，我抬起头。
lines.en: Something trampled the mycelium, and I look up.

lines.zh: 那影子在林子里太显眼。
lines.en: That shadow stands out too much in this wood.

lines.zh: 它离小菌太近了，我得过去。
lines.en: It's too close to the sprouts; I must go.

lines.zh: 我先竖起菌盖，让自己看着大些。
lines.en: I raise my cap to look bigger.

lines.zh: 它踩碎了一朵同类，我记住了。
lines.en: It crushed one of my kin, and I remember.

lines.zh: 风把它的味道送过来，是铁和烟。
lines.en: The wind brings its scent: iron and smoke.

lines.zh: 我朝那个方向挪，孢子先飘过去。
lines.en: I shift that way, spores drifting ahead of me.

lines.zh: 它以为我不会动，我动了。
lines.en: It thought I wouldn't move; I did.

lines.zh: 我得站在它和小菌中间。
lines.en: I need to stand between it and the sprouts.

lines.zh: 林子里的事，我一般都管。
lines.en: Matters in this wood usually concern me.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，孢子越散越多。
lines.en: I fix on it, and my spores thicken.

lines.zh: 它往左，我慢慢转过去。
lines.en: It goes left; I turn slowly after it.

lines.zh: 我挡在路口，它绕不过去。
lines.en: I block the path, and it can't get around.

lines.zh: 它一靠近，菌盖就压低。
lines.en: As it nears, my cap lowers.

lines.zh: 我的根须在土下伸向它。
lines.en: My roots reach toward it under the soil.

lines.zh: 它退，我不追，只站着。
lines.en: It retreats; I don't chase, I just stand.

lines.zh: 孢子糊住它的眼睛，它就慢了。
lines.en: Spores cloud its eyes, and it slows.

lines.zh: 我数它的脚步，一步比一步近。
lines.en: I count its steps, closer each time.

lines.zh: 它停在原地，我也不动。
lines.en: It stops, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我把整片菌丝都叫醒了。
lines.en: I've woken the whole mycelium network.

lines.zh: 我用菌盖撞它，撒出一片孢子。
lines.en: I ram it with my cap and release a cloud of spores.

lines.zh: 我的根须缠住它的脚。
lines.en: My roots wrap around its foot.

lines.zh: 它砍下来，我软软地让开。
lines.en: It swings down, and I yield softly aside.

lines.zh: 我顶它一下，像推一颗松果。
lines.en: I butt it once, like pushing a pinecone.

lines.zh: 孢子进了它的鼻子，它咳起来。
lines.en: Spores get in its nose, and it coughs.

lines.zh: 我被砍掉一角菌盖，还在往前。
lines.en: A piece of my cap is cut away, and I keep coming.

lines.zh: 我把它往湿泥里按。
lines.en: I press it down into the wet mud.

lines.zh: 它踩住我，我就从根上冒出新芽。
lines.en: It pins me, and a new shoot rises from my root.

lines.zh: 我用菌柄扫它的小腿。
lines.en: I sweep its shin with my stalk.

lines.zh: 打完我自己也歪了，慢慢扶正。
lines.en: Afterward I'm crooked and slowly straighten.

lines.zh: 我从湿土里拱出来，顶开落叶。
lines.en: I push up through wet soil, lifting the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 菌盖还小，我先站稳根。
lines.en: My cap is still small; first I root myself.

lines.zh: 雨后的林子，正好长菌。
lines.en: After the rain, the wood is just right for mushrooms.

lines.zh: 我身边都是同类，我们不说话。
lines.en: Kin surround me, and we say nothing.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看见的是苔藓和树根。
lines.en: The first things I see are moss and roots.

lines.zh: 孢子从我头顶散开，飘进暗处。
lines.en: Spores drift from my head into the dark.

lines.zh: 这片地很潮，我很满意。
lines.en: This ground is damp, and I'm content.

lines.zh: 我慢慢长高，长到能看见路。
lines.en: I grow slowly until I can see the path.

lines.zh: 有只甲虫从我脚边爬过。
lines.en: A beetle crawls past my foot.

lines.zh: 我先认下这块湿土。
lines.en: I claim this patch of wet soil first.

lines.zh: 菌盖边缘焦了，味道很难闻。
lines.en: My cap's edge scorches, and it smells awful.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，沾了一身泥。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and come up muddy.

lines.zh: 水漫过菌盖，我只能往上顶。
lines.en: Water covers my cap, and I can only push upward.

lines.zh: 泥土炸开，我的根全露出来了。
lines.en: The soil bursts, and all my roots are exposed.

lines.zh: 箭穿过菌盖，留下一个圆孔。
lines.en: An arrow pierces my cap and leaves a round hole.

lines.zh: 一股冷意冻住菌丝，我不太能动。
lines.en: A cold spell freezes my mycelium, and I can barely move.

lines.zh: 湿土干了，我的菌盖开始皱。
lines.en: The soil has dried, and my cap begins to wrinkle.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，我听见自己在变。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me, and I hear myself changing.

lines.zh: 土没了，我的根须抓着空气。
lines.en: The soil is gone, and my roots grasp at air.
